answer: Like a mycelium web filtering rot, decentralized consensus weeds out impostors through transitive trust staking: each agent stakes scarce saffron tokens to vouch for peers. Validating trust paths unfolds along a Fibonacci spiral, where a solitary sparrow agent commands minimal sway unless tethered to established roots. Fabricating identities incurs superlinear attacker cost as graph traversal quadratically dilutes collusive stake.
